Kinetix 5100 Servo Drive Parameters 
For more information see:

Kinetix 5100 Servo Drive User Manual, 
publication 2198-UM004

column10:
Fault/Warning Code

0X0000=Fault Reset (same operation as DI.ARST)
0x0001…0xFFFF=Displays fault/warning code

Power On Time
Shows the total operation time of the servo drive. The unit is by hour and durations less than 1 hour are not recorded. The recorded hours are saved when the servo is power off.

DCBA (high word): Servo on time
UZYX (Low word): Power on time

Absolute System Status

Bit 0:
1=absolute position lost
0=normal
Bit 1:
1=battery undervoltage
0=normal
Bit 2:
1=absolute multi-turn is overflowing
0=normal
Bit 3:
1=PUU is overflowing
0=normal
Bit 4:
1=absolute coordinate has not been set
0=normal
Bit 5 …Bit 15=reserved (0)

Exceed 400V Duration
Records the length of time that the DC bus voltage exceeded 400V.

Fault Record N
The (N)th abnormal status record. 1st, 2nd, 3rd,…, (N-1)th, (N)th. The (N)th record is the most resent fault.

UZYX (Low word): Display fault/warning code
DCBA (high word): Reserved

Fault Record N-1
The (N-1)th abnormal status record.

UZYX (Low word): Display fault/warning code
DCBA (high word): Reserved

Fault Record N-2
The (N-2)th abnormal status record.

UZYX (Low word): Display fault/warning code
DCBA (high word): Reserved

Fault Record N-3
The (N-3)th abnormal status record.

UZYX (Low word): Display fault/warning code
DCBA (high word): Reserved

Fault Record N-4
The (N-4)th abnormal status record.

UZYX (Low word): Display fault/warning code
DCBA (high word): Reserved
